businessRules.statement: Institution BIC MUST match ISO 9362 (8 or 11 alnum chars). Each BIC MUST map to exactly one DID.
Every credit-transfer message gets a fresh UETR (UUIDv4). Resubmission with the same uetr returns the original (idempotency).
screening.decision: sanctioned → REJECT; amount ≥ 10M → REVIEW; coverPayment & not sanctioned → REVIEW; else APPROVE.
An acknowledgement MUST reference an existing PENDING message by uetr. Status transitions: PENDING → SETTLED (ACK) | REJECTED (NACK).
Message rows are insert-once. status updates limited to ACK/NACK transition; original payload is immutable.
